panels.title: Relay
panels.description: The relay's /healthz, asked on the host.

panels.title: Public HTTPS
panels.description: relay.arbos.life/healthz and arbos.life through DNS, Caddy and TLS.

panels.title: Kill switch
panels.description: On: every model call is refused and no agent can work. Trips when today's spend reaches the daily cap.

panels.title: Spend of cap
panels.description: Relay-wide spend since 00:00 UTC against the cap that trips the kill switch.

panels.title: Model errors
panels.description: Upstream model calls that did not answer 2xx.

panels.title: Model p95
panels.description: Time until the provider starts answering.

panels.title: Targets down
panels.description: Targets that answered in the last day and do not now. Boxes are on the Agents dashboard.

targets.expr: count(up{job!="arbos-agentd"} == 0 and on (job, instance) max_over_time(up[1d]) == 1) or vector(0)

panels.title: Boxes running
panels.description: arbos-box-* containers Docker is running.

panels.title: Box slots used
panels.description: Admitted boxes against max_boxes. At 100% new sign-ups go on the waitlist.

panels.title: Start fails (1h)
panels.description: Wake jobs whose box did not start.

panels.title: Wake queue
panels.description: Wake jobs queued or in flight.

panels.title: Boxes working
panels.description: Boxes with a turn running in the last 3 minutes.

panels.title: Containers
panels.description: Every Docker container cAdvisor sees. A drop to none means Docker or cAdvisor is down.

panels.title: Disk free
panels.description: The fuller of the root filesystem and Docker's data.

panels.title: Days to disk full
panels.description: Free space divided by how fast it shrank over the last 6 hours.

panels.title: Relay sockets
panels.description: Open room websockets (devices and boxes); before the relay reports them, all sockets its processes hold.

panels.title: DB wait p95
panels.description: How long a caller waits for the relay's SQLite writer lock.

panels.title: Box wake time
panels.description: Wake started until the box connected back: what a waiting user feels.

panels.title: Service restarts per hour
panels.description: How often each systemd service's cgroup was re-created.

panels.title: Probes and certificates
panels.description: How long each health probe took, and how many days each certificate has left.
